title: Hunts FH-031T: Credit the Event stop at the door and prove the finale on a preview deployment
detail: FH-031S put the finale on the author and player screens and behind the reward grant. Still owed. By an agent: (1) an Event stop credits through hunt_claim_apply with finaleDoorEvidence at assurance event_door, only for a seat the host marked present at the host Event (the function exists in lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts and nothing calls it); (2) the player's Trail page lists the rewards of the run and calls POST /api/hunts/rewards/grant, which today has no caller on a screen, and nothing lets an author create a reward. By the owner (Daniel) or a person he names: (3) apply migration 20270346085000_hunt_reward_finale_seat.sql after its pgTAP test is green in CI; (4) the acceptance run on a preview deployment with the Hunts switches on there only: a finished player with no seat at a full host Event sees the full message and holds no RSVP, ticket or reward afterwards. Requires FH-031S and FH-020. Hunts switches stay OFF in production.
